spec_match.rationale: Each card exercises a Behavior-section rule with a real window.open() call: legacy popup trap, popup=0 guard, split+popup, noopener null, invalid hints, named-target reuse, activation gating.

interactive.rationale: Seven run buttons plus close-all, with per-case expected vs observed output.

edge_cases.rationale: Cases the page cannot test (already-split window, UA declining on narrow or mobile windows) are listed as manual rather than faked.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the spec/explainer sections it exercises.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: 6/7 cases matched; the no-activation case returned a WindowProxy because Playwright disables popup blocking, and the page honestly prints DIFFERENT FROM EXPECTED with that explanation; no console errors; 0px overflow. the API is absent in Chromium 153 even with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features / --enable-blink-features=WindowOpenSplitTab, so only the legacy branch was observed, and headless has no split-view UI.

telemetry_health.rationale: One assertion per case; the late-call case only passes when the call is actually blocked.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons override both background and color; verdict colours use emerald-dark/rose on stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Cards with headings, labelled buttons and aria-live outputs.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Cards stack on mobile; no overflow.

openQuestions.title: Observe activation gating in a real (non-automated) browser
openQuestions.detail: Automation disables the popup blocker. Run the late-call case by hand in Chrome to record the null return.

guidanceConsulted.query: window.open popup features link opener noopener
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Be deliberate about opener relationships; use noopener/COOP when the opened page should not control the opener.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: noopener and rel=opener are explicit, visible toggles, and the copy explains that a split keeps the opener by default.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status live region announce async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results via polite live regions; keep native buttons/labels; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/outputs are role=status or aria-live=polite; all controls are native buttons/inputs with visible text labels and a 3px focus outline; min 44px targets.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic grid tracks (minmax(min(100%, Xrem), 1fr)) and wrap long monospace strings so nothing overflows at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Card grids use minmax(min(100%,…),1fr); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3.

summary: Real calls for each fallback rule, with honest mismatch reporting where automation differs.
